g.title: crate Composes a planned frame on the CPU or the GPU, with its exports.
crate::build Which optional parts this build of the compositor contains.
crate::cache Previous frame's chunk and layer records: the plan's pure cache index.
crate::cpu The CPU executor: draws planned frames into premultiplied RGBA8 pixmaps.
crate::cpu::blend Blend modes and Porter–Duff operators on premultiplied colors (§8.7).
crate::cpu::blur Gaussian blur of premultiplied pixels by repeated halving (§8.8.1).
crate::cpu::compositor CpuCompositor: runs a planned frame on the calling thread.
crate::cpu::draw Executes one DrawOp: samples, applies coverage and blends into its target.
crate::cpu::effects Shared CPU effect helpers: blur deviations, drop shadows, color matrices.
crate::cpu::filters Runs the layer filters of an Op::Filter on the CPU (design §8.8).
crate::cpu::graph Filter graphs on the CPU: the evaluator and its primitives (§8.8.4).
crate::cpu::graph::apply Runs a filter graph of SVG primitives on the CPU (design §8.8.4).
crate::cpu::graph::component_transfer feComponentTransfer on the CPU (per-channel transfer functions).
crate::cpu::graph::composite feComposite with the arithmetic operator on premultiplied colors.
crate::cpu::graph::displacement_map feDisplacementMap on the CPU (each pixel takes its mapped source pixel).
crate::cpu::graph::lighting feDiffuseLighting and feSpecularLighting on the CPU.
crate::cpu::graph::morphology feMorphology on the CPU (erode and dilate over a pixel window).
crate::cpu::graph::turbulence feTurbulence on the CPU (Perlin noise by the SVG reference algorithm).
crate::cpu::mask Clip coverage and mask layers applied to a surface (design §8.9).
crate::cpu::surface Premultiplied RGBA8 pixel buffers of the CPU compositor and sampling.
crate::gpu The GPU executor (feature `gpu`): declarations and re-exports only.
crate::gpu::context Creates a GPU context on a hardware adapter and device.
crate::gpu::draw Records the draw operations of a plan (design §8.7).
crate::gpu::exec Runs one frame's plan on the GPU: targets, chunks, ops and exports.
crate::gpu::export Sends drawable frames to their sinks' export pools (design §8.12).
crate::gpu::export_pool The export pools by sink, and what each sink last received.
crate::gpu::external Images that external render engines share with a GPU context.
crate::gpu::filters Records the layer filters of a plan (design §8.8).
crate::gpu::graph Records a filter graph's primitives (design §8.8.4).
crate::gpu::mask Records the masks and clips of a target (design §8.9).
crate::gpu::offscreen Offscreen rendering and readback of textures.
crate::gpu::pass Helpers the GPU processes share: render passes, views and copies.
crate::gpu::pipelines The compositor's pipelines, layouts and shared buffers.
crate::gpu::shader Records user shader draws and filter shaders (design §8.10, §8.8.5).
crate::gpu::shader_cache The user shaders' layouts, samplers and pipeline cache.
crate::gpu::shared_images The GPU context's imports of externally shared images.
crate::gpu::state The GPU context, its environment and the window surfaces.
crate::gpu::surface Presenting to a window through a wgpu surface (a swapchain).
crate::gpu::targets Target textures of a frame, and a pool of the free ones.
crate::output The frame report alias of the GPU executor.
crate::plan Plans one composition frame into draw operations, with cache reuse and damage.
crate::plan::bounds Where each command of a render scene can draw, in scene coordinates.
crate::plan::builder The planning state of one frame and the entry that plans it.
crate::plan::context3d 3D contexts: planes sharing a context, drawn in depth order (§8.4).
crate::plan::damage Chunk rasters and window damage: which chunks and rectangles change (§8.6).
crate::plan::frame Shared plan types and free helpers for the planning leaves.
crate::plan::hash FNV-1a 64-bit hashes of the plan's commands, paints, effects and layers.
crate::plan::items Items of a layer drawn into a destination: rasters, externals, shaders, clips.
crate::plan::layers Layers: geometry, raster scale, signatures, surfaces, backdrops and effects.
crate::plan::ops The plan's data types: targets, chunk tasks, ops, damage and errors.
crate::plan::polygon Convex polygons in 3D: projecting rectangles, planes and splitting.
crate::plan::validate Checks that a composition is a tree the plan can draw.
crate::tables Tables shared by the CPU and the GPU: colour transfer and turbulence lattice.
